component.name: Sticky Notes
component.summary: The lightest, prettiest sticky notes app on Linux

description.p: Sticky notes. That's it. That's the app. No cloud, no account, no "AI note assistant," no spatial canvas you have to pan around just to find your grocery list. Just outrageously pretty notes that stick to your desktop and then get out of your way.

ul.li: Frameless and rounded with soft drop shadows
Seven hand-picked colours, including a charcoal dark mode
Calm by default: the formatting toolbar only shows on the note you are typing in
See-through notes: fade a note's paper down to 50% while the text stays solid
Collapse any note to a tidy bar with a double-click; checklists still show what is left
Rich text: bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, bullet lists and checklists
Lists that keep themselves going: type "1." or "-" and Enter starts the next item, renumbered for you
Keep a note on top of every other window
All notes: search every note and filter by colour
Share a note as a short bit of text; the other person previews it before adding it
Lives in the system tray and quietly restores your notes at login

description.p: Your notes live on your machine, in a plain local config file. No servers, no telemetry, no account to create before you can write the word "milk."

screenshot.caption: Notes in seven colours, with a numbered list, a pinned checklist and a collapsed note
Colours, opacity, keep on top and sharing; the text stays solid while the paper fades
Everything a click away in the system tray, with your recent notes
All notes: search every note and filter by colour
Receive a shared note and preview it before adding it

description.p: Now on Flathub. In the Flatpak version, starting at login is requested from your desktop, so it works inside the sandbox.

ul.li: Calmer notes: the formatting toolbar only shows while you type
All notes window with search and a colour filter
A preview before adding a shared note

description.p: Typed lists ("1.", "a.", "-") continue, nest and renumber themselves.
Share a note as a piece of text and receive notes others share with you.
